# One search, one line

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`one-search-one-line` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](one-search-one-line.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> On three lines, a line is the sole one differing from the others exactly where the three are 乾 or 坤 with the line at that height turned: 震, 坎, 艮 are 坤 searched at the bottom, middle and top, and 巽, 離, 兌 乾 so searched.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Turning the line at a height of three, and the sole line at that height, are defined; at each height the line is sole exactly where the three are 乾 or 坤 so turned, and the six searched trigrams are 震, 坎, 艮, 巽, 離, 兌. (`Becoming.Hexagram.Trigram.flip3`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Trigram.soleAt`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Trigram.sole_iff_searched`, `Becoming.Hexagram.Trigram.searched`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; trigrams as triples of Boolean lines, bottom first.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>

- The family reading of 說卦 (the sons and daughters).
